name: get_fact_history
description: Return the append-only event lineage for (tenant_id, subject, predicate) in observed order: op, outcome, value, source, assessor_type, confidence, policy_version, temporal fields, and hash-chain links. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar).

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.
